Rava (re-told): but if he designated it for insulating, one may move it

Rebbi (via Ravin's chain): but if he designated it for insulating, he may move it

palm branches cut for wood, about which he reconsidered [and decided] to sit [on them]: he must tie [them]
RSBG: he need not tie [them]
